note: Tag keys a place record may carry. Each tag needs a named source; ownership and welcome tags are never inferred from a name, a photograph or a hunch. Tier cited = a named page; harvested = a public directory or list fetched by a tool; field = someone stood there.

entries.label: Black-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a Black-owned business directory, an SFA oral history

entries.label: Woman-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a women-owned business certification (WBENC, WOSB)

entries.label: LGBTQ+ welcoming
entries.evidence: the business's own statement, a press list whose framing says the businesses in it are LGBTQ-owned, or a public directory (an LGBTQ chamber of commerce, a Pride business list, OpenStreetMap lgbtq=welcome); never inferred

entries.label: Cooks over wood
entries.evidence: True 'Cue certification, the NCBS Historic Barbecue Trail, the SCBA, an SFA interview, a press piece describing the pit, the pit's own site

entries.label: Whole hog
entries.evidence: what the pit says it cooks, or a press piece

entries.label: Family-run
entries.evidence: a press profile or the business's own history

entries.label: Cash only
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Closes when sold out
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Buffet
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Weekends only
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Serves hash
entries.evidence: a menu or a press piece

entries.label: Closed
entries.evidence: a dated press piece or the business's own notice
